# Copilot instructions

Before suggesting or generating code, read [`docs/PRD.md`](../docs/PRD.md) and
follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

Key points: Nuxt 4 stable, all CV content in `app/data/cv.ts` (typed by
`app/types/cv.ts`, read through `useCv()`), keep the data contract stable, and
be creative with layout and styling.
